modelExecutionHeaders clones inbound HTTP headers into executor Options.Headers. schedulerOptions subsequently clones Options.Headers into SchedulerPickRequest.Options.Headers, so raw inbound Authorization / X-Api-Key / X-Goog-Api-Key values remain visible to scheduler plugins.

APIKeyFromContext reads ginCtx["userApiKey"], NewUsageReporter stores that value in reporter.apiKey, and UsageReporter.buildRecordForModel copies it into usage.Record.APIKey.

usageAdapter.HandleUsage translates usage.Record.APIKey into pluginapi.UsageRecord.APIKey, exposing raw client credentials to usage accounting plugins under built-in config access. Established by source evidence only.
